title: rcStep
body:
## rcStep

Simulates an initially uncharged series resistor feeding a grounded capacitor when a constant voltage is switched on at t = 0, and reports the source and capacitor node voltages at evenly spaced times. Native transient values are resampled and checked against V x (1 - exp(-t/RC)). Outputs match the other analyses (results.csv with time in seconds, summary and netlist). Choose it for RC charging and settling-time checks only.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The circuit must be exactly source - resistor - response node - capacitor - ground; any other topology fails with UNSUPPORTED_CIRCUIT.
- stop (seconds) must lie between 0.01 and 20 time constants R x C; the default 0.005 s suits only RC values near 0.25 to 500 ms.
- The default probe is "out"; name the capacitor node "out" or list the actual node in probes.

Native binding: `ngspice tran/linearize`. Output kind: `["table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `circuit` | The circuit, written inline: one ideal voltage source between ground (node "0") and the source node, 1 to 64 resistors, up to 64 capacitors, up to 64 uncoupled inductors (acSweep only) and the nodes to publish. At most 16 non-ground nodes; no netlist, device model or subcircuit can be imported. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"default":"in"},"resistors":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"required":true,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"resistance":{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0,"required":true}}}},"capacitors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"capacitance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-12,"maximum":1,"required":true}}}},"probes":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":16,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"default":["out"]}}}` | **required** |
| `stop` | DC stop is source volts (default 5), AC stop is positive Hz (default 10000), RC stop is seconds (default 0.005). RC duration must be 0.01–20 R*C time constants. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":1000000.0}` | `0.005` |
| `points` | Sample control, default 101: for linear AC it is total frequencies including endpoints (3–512); for decade/octave it is nominal points per decade/octave and actual count must be 3–512. DC/RC use total uniform samples. Narrow resonances need appropriate density; requirements inspect only sampled points. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":512}` | `101` |
| `amplitude` | Nonzero source phasor/step amplitude in volts, range -1000 to 1000, default 1. In AC amplitudeConvention explicitly interprets phasors as peak (default) or rms and controls power factor. Negative source amplitude reverses native voltage/current phasors while relative transfer phase and power remain consistent. rcStep uses the step height. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-1000,"maximum":1000}` | `1` |
